body.name: Back-door-identified input outside the front-door family
body.construction: \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}=(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}},1,2,1,0,1)\), where \(V=\{1,2\}\), \(\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}}_1=\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}}_2=\{0,1\}\), and \(H_{\mathrm{out}}\) has the single directed edge \(1\to2\), no directed self-loop, and no bidirected edge. Thus \(X=1\), \(Y=2\), \(L=\gamma=1\), \(x=0\), and \(y=1\).
